description: Web analytics from Simple Analytics - aggregated page views, visitors, top pages, referrers, UTM values, devices and event counts, raw data point exports, and website management on the account.

api.description: Export raw page views and events for a date range as JSON datapoints, unsampled, with the fields you name

fields.description: The website hostname as registered, such as example.com.
Defaults to 30 days ago.
Defaults to today.
An IANA name with capitals, such as Europe/Amsterdam.

fields.description: Always send this: without it the legacy field set comes back, and type=all fails.
Page views, events, or both. Defaults to pageviews.
Include robots and crawlers. Defaults to false.
Metadata keys to export with their storage suffix, such as project_text (sent as metadata.project_text). The suffix is required here, unlike in Stats filters.

api.description: Read aggregated stats for one website: page views, visitors, top pages, countries, referrers, UTM values, browsers, operating systems, devices, time on page and event counts

fields.description: The website hostname as registered, such as example.com.
Only this page path, such as /contact. The path goes into the URL, before .json.
Defaults to one month ago.
Defaults to today.
An IANA name with capitals, such as Europe/Amsterdam.

fields.type: (pageviews | visitors | histogram | pages | countries | referrers | utm_sources | utm_mediums | utm_campaigns | utm_contents | utm_terms | browser_names | os_names | device_types | seconds_on_page)[]
fields.description: The fields to return. Always send at least one: an empty fields list returns the version 1 format.
How many rows each field returns, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 50.
The bucket size for histogram. Defaults to day.
Event names to count. Use ["*"] for every event, capped at 1000.
One exact page path.
A comma separated list of paths. A trailing * matches by prefix, such as /product/*.
A two-letter country code.
Exact metadata matches, sent as metadata.<key>. Keys use letters, digits and underscores only, without the storage suffix.
